subject: SpectraNet temporary tenant debug trace disposition playbook
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@spectranet.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-04T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary extension for tenant debug traces during pilot

Hi Sergio / Kimberly,

Quick note from the SpectraNet engineering and legal teams: for the upcoming pilot (DN-8721) we need to retain tenant-scoped debug traces for 90 days (our standard otherwise is 30 days) to support internal troubleshooting and a limited forensics window while we ramp. Our SOC 2 auditor flagged this as an exception that needs documented controls and artefacts (SIG/CAIQ entries + evidence).

Can Redwood support a scoped, timeboxed retention extension that:
- only applies to the pilot tenant(s) listed in the attached spec,
- redacts customer PII at ingress where possible,
- limits access to on-call SRE + named SpectraNet contacts, and
- provides an evidence bundle we can share with our auditor (config snapshot + sampled access logs + deletion proof).

Attaching the pilot spec for context. Legal would like a short playbook that we can append to our contract for the duration of the pilot.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call if helpful.

— Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform Security, SpectraNet
Attachments: spectranet-pilot-spec.pdf

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@spectranet.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-04T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary extension for tenant debug traces during pilot

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the spec. We can support a scoped temporary retention policy but want to propose a pragmatic playbook so we balance forensic needs with our SOC 2 commitments. Draft proposal below (high level):

1) Scope: pilot tenant IDs only (explicit config flag), no cross-tenant elevation.
2) Retention window: 45 days by default for the pilot (45 is a compromise between 30/90) — we can extend to 90 days if legal provides a signed addendum accepting compensating controls.
3) Data minimization: we will apply ingress redaction rules for PII fields defined in the attached spec; if redaction cannot be applied safely we will store encrypted blobs with restricted access.
4) Access control: access only via a temporary role that expires at pilot end; all SRE access is logged with reason codes.
5) Deletion proof: automated weekly deletion job + signed manifest exported to Google Drive; we can provide a sample retention-config snapshot and a sample of the access log events tied to a ticket for audit.

I'll attach a short playbook draft for your legal/audit review — it's intentionally minimal so it can be appended to the master services agreement as an addendum. Kimberly / Marissa — can you validate SOC 2 / SIG implications and list the evidence artefacts we should generate for SpectraNet's auditor?

If SpectraNet accepts 45 days we can turn this on via tenant flag in the staging environment within 48 hours. If SpectraNet insists on 90 days we need DocuSign confirmation and an agreed compensating-control checklist.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Customer Security — Redwood Inference
Attachments: playbook-draft.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@spectranet.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-05T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary extension for tenant debug traces during pilot

Sergio / Elena — quick compliance view:

Thanks for the draft. High-level items to cover before we give SpectraNet an approval that will satisfy SOC 2 / SIG reviewers:
- Narrow scope in writing (tenant IDs + timeframe + list of retained fields). Anything broader is a failing SOC 2 control for data minimization.
- Document the compensating controls if retention > 45 days: e.g., mandatory redaction at ingestion, KMS key separation per tenant, quarterly access review (or more frequent during pilot).
- Evidence list we need to produce for auditor: retention-config-snapshot (timestamped), sampled access-log events (with correlated ticket ids), screenshot of UI toggle with tenant flag, deletion run manifest (hash), and the redaction rule set we applied.
- CAIQ/SIG: map the playbook lines to CAIQ questions A.2/A.3 (data retention) and the SIG control entries for logging and key management. We'll need to mark those fields in the SIG matrix as "Customer-scoped deviation — temporary".

Operational asks for SRE (cc Marissa): please prepare a test export (sanitized) containing: retention-config-snapshot.csv, an access-log-sample.csv that shows role + reason-code, and the deletion-manifest example. Marissa — once we have those artifacts I can sign off on the limited 45-day approval.

Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of InfoSec Compliance — Redwood Inference

Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-05T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary extension for tenant debug traces during pilot

Elena — thanks, we can operationalize a 45-day scoped retention while the pilot is running. A couple of practical next steps so SpectraNet can present a clean artefact bundle to your auditor: 

1) We will generate the following sample artefacts and attach them to the Drive folder you shared: retention-config-snapshot.csv, access-log-sample.csv (redacted identifiers), and deletion-manifest-202707XX.json (example).
2) We need SpectraNet to sign the retention addendum (DocuSign) that accepts the compensating controls if you want >45 days.
3) Please confirm the exact tenant IDs and the email addresses of your on-call SREs who should be granted temporary access (we will issue timebound roles).

I'll start compiling the artefact bundle once SRE gives me the exports. Sergio / Kimberly — tagging you to ensure the CAIQ/SIG mapping is documented in the same Drive folder so the auditor sees the linkage.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Compliance Manager — Redwood Inference
Attachments to follow: retention-config-snapshot.csv, access-log-sample.csv

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@spectranet.com>

Thanks everyone — SpectraNet accepts the 45-day interim solution. We will sign the DocuSign addendum for 90 days only if absolutely necessary; for now we will proceed with 45 days and the compensating controls you outlined.

Confirmed pilot tenant IDs: tenant-spectra-001, tenant-spectra-002.
On-call SREs to grant access: jason.holt@spectranet.com, priya.kim@spectranet.com.

Elena (on behalf of SpectraNet)
